trg: Mokolo moko, mama ya Juan azwaki ekateli ya kosala taco ya speciale.

src: She filled it with all of his favorite ingredients: ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.
trg: Atondisaki yango na biloko oyo alingaka: ngombe, madesu, tomate, fromaze, mpe supu a ngai.

src: Juan was so excited for his taco that he could barely wait to eat it.
trg: Juan asepelaki mingi na taco wana yango wana ndenge ya kozela mpo na kolya yango ezalaki te.

src: When Juan finally took a bite of his taco, he was amazed at how delicious it was.
trg: Ntango nsukansuka Juan azwaki ndambo ya taco na ye, akamwaki ndenge ezali elengi makasi.

src: The flavors of the meat, vegetables, and cheese all combined perfectly to create a taste that Juan had never experienced before.
trg: Elengi ya mosuni, ya bandunda, mpe ya fromaze esangani malamu mpo na kosala elengi oyo Juan atikala koyoka nanu te.

src: He ate every bite of his taco, and then he asked his mother to make him another one.
trg: Alyaki taco na ye mokemoke, mpe na nsima asengaki mama na ye na kolambela ye mosusu.

src: Juan's mother was happy to make him another taco, and she even let him help her in the kitchen.
trg: Mama ya Juan asepelaki kolambela ye taco mosusu, mpe apesaki nkutu Juan nzela ya kosalisa ye na kikuku.

src: Juan learned how to measure the ingredients, how to cook the meat, and how to assemble the tacos.
trg: Juan ayekolaka mingi ya biloko asengeli kotya, ndenge ya kolamba mosuoni, mpe ndenge ya kosangisa tacos.

src: He had so much fun helping his mother that he decided that he wanted to be a chef when he grew up.
trg: Asepelaki mingi na kosalisa mama na ye yango wana azwaki ekateli ya kozela molambi ntango akokola.

src: Juan continued to love tacos throughout his childhood.
trg: Juan akobaki kolinga tacos na bomwana na ye nyonso.

src: He ate them at home, at school, and at restaurants.
trg: Alyaka yango na ndako, na kelasi, mpe na malewa.

src: The federal government is considering adding a new species of colorful fish to the list of protected species.
trg: Guvernema ya federale ezali kolinga kobakisa balolenge ya sika ya mbisi ya langi na liste ya biliko basengeli kobatela.

src: The fish, known as the "rainbow mouth" fish, is found only in a small area of the Pacific Ocean.
trg: Mbisi, eyebani na nkombo mbisi "ya monoko monama", ezalaka kaka na esika moko ya Mbu ya Pacifique.

src: It is named for its bright colors and distinctive mouth, which is shaped like a rainbow.
trg: Ezwi nkombo na kolanda balangi na yango ya makasi mpe monoko na yango ya kokesena, oyo ezali neti monama.

src: The members of the Fish and Wildlife Service are divided on whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species.
trg: Bato ya Mosala ya Bambisi mpe ya Banyama bazalaki koyokana te soki esengeli kobakisa mbisi ya monoko ya monama na liste ya biloko basengeli kobatela.

src: Some members argue that the fish is not in danger of extinction and does not need federal protection.
trg: Bato mosusu balobi ete mbisi wana ezali te na likama ya kosila mpe ezali kosenga ete boyangeli ya federale ebatela yango.

src: Others argue that the fish is unique and should be protected from overfishing.
trg: Basusu balobi ete mbisi wana ekeseni mpe esengeli kobatela yango mpo basilisa yango te.

src: The decision of whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species is likely to be a difficult one.
trg: Ekateli ya kobakisa mbisi ya monoko ya monama to te na molongo ya biloko oyo basengeli kobatela ekozala ekateli ya mpasi.

src: Feel the warmth of the blanket seeping into your body, and let your muscles relax.
trg: Yoka moto ya bulangeti ezali kokota na nzoto na yo, mpe tika misisa na yo enyolisama.

src: Close your eyes and take a deep breath.
trg: Kanga miso mpe pema makasi.

src: Inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
trg: Benda mopepe na zolo mpe bimisa yango na monoko.

src: Repeat this several times, letting your mind clear and your body become still.
trg: Sala bongo mbala ebele, tika makanisi na yo ezala polele mpe nzoto na yo esika moko.

src: As you relax, imagine yourself in a beautiful place.
trg: Ntango ozali kominyolisa, kanisa ozali na esika moko ya kitoko.

src: It could be a beach, a forest, or a mountaintop.
trg: Ekoki kozala libongo, zamba, to nsonge ya ngomba.

src: Whatever place you choose, make it a place where you feel happy and at peace.
trg: Ata oponi esika nini, sala ete ezala esika ozali komiyoka na esengo mpe na kimya.

src: See the sights, hear the sounds, and smell the smells of your chosen place.
trg: Mona bisika ya kitoko, yoka makelele, mpe yoka bansolo ya esika oponi.

src: Feel the sun on your skin and the breeze in your hair.
trg: Yoka moi na mposo na yo mpe mopepe na nsuki na yo.

src: Let yourself relax in this place for as long as you like.
trg: Minyolisa na esika oyo na eleko ya molai ndenge olingi.

src: When you're ready to return to the present, take a few deep breaths and open your eyes.
trg: Soki obongami na kozonga na ngonga oyo, pema makasi mbala mwa mingi mpe fungola miso.

src: You'll feel refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to take on the day.
trg: Okomiyoka malamu mpe na makasi, obongami na kobanda mokolo.

src: This is just one example of a relaxation technique that you can use to relieve stress and improve your overall well-being.
trg: Oyo eza kaka ndakisa moko ya mayele ya kominyolisa oyo okoki kosalela mpo na kokitisa stress na yo mpe komatisa bolamu na yo.

src: There are many other relaxation techniques available, so find one that works for you and make it a part of your daily routine.
trg: Ezali na mayele mingi mosusu ya kominyolisa, yango wana luka oyo ebongi na yo mpe koma kosalela yango mokolo na mokolo.

src: With a little practice, you'll be able to relax on command, whenever you need to.
trg: Soki osali ngalasisi moke, okokoka kominyolisa ndenge olingi, ntango nyonso olingi.

src: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
trg: Ezali ntina na kobosana te bambwa batungisaka mpenza te, mpe ete bambwa ebele bazalaka bikelamu ya bizaleli ya malamu mpe ya bolingo.

src: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
trg: Kasi, ezali na makambo mosusu oyo ekoki kobakisa likambo ete mbwa eswa yo, neti soki bateya mbwa malamu te, soki emoni neti bazali kobangisa ye, to soki bakangi ye na esika moko.

src: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
trg: Na likambo ya koswa ya mbwa ya kala te oyo babomaki koko ya mwasi, emonani ete bateyaki mbwa malamu te mpe ete ezali komona ete koko ya mwasi azali kobangisa ye.

src: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
trg: Mbwa wana ezalaki monene mpe ya makasi oyo basombaki na esika babatela yango mwa basanza libosa eswa ye.

src: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
trg: Koko ya mwasi akendaki kotala mwana na ye ya mobali mpe libota na ye, mpe azalaki kofanda na kiti ya monene ntango eswaki ye na mbala moko.

src: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
trg: Mbwa eswaki ye mbala ebele na moto mpe na kingo, mpe akufaki kaka na esika wana.

src: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
trg: Nkolo ya mbwa alobaki ete ayebaki ete mbwa na ye abundisaka bato, mpe ete akanisi eloko epusaki mbwa na kukendwa koswa koko mwasi ezali mpo koko asalaki muvema ya mbalakaka.

src: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
trg: Kasi, ezali ntina koyeba ete bambwa oyo bateya malamu ekoki kokoma mobulu soki emesana te malamu na bato to soki ezali komona ete bazali kobangisa ye.

src: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
trg: Likambo wana ya mabe ezali komonisa ntina ya bankolo bambwa oyo bazali na mokumba.

src: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.
trg: Hamid Al-fitr, mobeti-isolo ayebana mingi, alobeli ntango moko oyo azokaki na bitumba.

src: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.
trg: "Nazalaki elenge, oyo bauti kozwa na mosala, ntango namonaki bitumba na mbala ya liboso.

src: The fighting was fierce, and I was quickly overwhelmed.
trg: Bitumba ezalaki makasi, mpe elekelaki nga noki.

src: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.
trg: Nakweaki na eloko babetaki nga na moto, mpe nalalaki na mabele, makila ezotanga mpe nazali koyeba eloko te.

src: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.
trg: Ntango nalalaki wana, nakanisaki bomoi na nga mpe ndenge ekoki kosuka.

src: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.
trg: Nakanisaki libota mpe baninga na nga, mpe ndenge bakozala na mposa na nga.

src: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.
trg: Nakanisaki mpe lokumu oyo nazalaki koluka, mpe ndenge nazalaki lisusu te na likoki ya kozwa yango.

src: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.
trg: Nakangaki miso mpe nabongamaki na kokufa.

src: But then, I heard a voice.
trg: Kasi na nsima, nayokaki mongongo.

src: It was the voice of an old man, and he was saying, "Don't give up.
trg: Ezalaki mongongo ya mobange moko, mpe azalaki koloba, "Kotika te.

src: You're not done yet" I opened my eyes and saw the old man standing over me.
trg: Osilisi nanu te" Nafungolaki miso mpe namonaki mobange wana atelemi likolo na nga.

src: He was a healer, and he had come to help me.
trg: Azalaki mobikisi, mpe ayaki mpo na kosalisa nga.

src: He treated my wounds, and he gave me some words of encouragement:
trg: Atyaki nkisi na bampota na nga, mpe ayebisaki nga mwa maloba ya kolendisa:

src: Don't let this injury define you,' he said.
trg: Alobaki ete, Kotika te mpota oyo elakisi bomoto na yo.'

src: "You're still a warrior, and you still have a lot to offer the world.
trg: "Ozali kaka mobundi, mpe ozali na makambo ya ebele ya kopesa na mokili.

src: Health and fitness are important for feeling your best and living a long, happy life.
trg: Santé na kolongono ya nzoto ezali ntina mpo na komiyoka malamu mpe kozala na bomoi ya molai mpe ya esengo.

src: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you maintain a healthy weight, reduce your risk of chronic diseases, and improve your mood and energy levels.
trg: Kolya malamu mpe kosala ngalasisi mbala na mbala ekoki kosalisa na kozala na kilo ya malamu, kokitisa likama ya maladi oyo esilaka te, mpe kobongisa humeur mpe nivo ya energie na yo.

src: Eating a healthy diet means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
trg: Kolya bilei ya malamu elimboli kolya mingi bambuma, bandunda, mpe mbuma ya mobimba.

src: It also means limiting unhealthy fats, processed foods, and sugary drinks.
trg: Elakisi me kotya ndelo na bilei ya mafuta, bilei basila kolamba mpe masanga ya sukali.

src: Regular exercise can include activities such as walking, running, swimming, biking, or dancing.
trg: Kosala ngalasisi mbala na mbala etali makambo neti kotambola, kopota mbango, kobeta mai, kokumba velo, to kobina.

src: It is important to get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week.
trg: Ezali mpe ntina kosala soki moke miniti 150 ya mosala ya mwa makasi ya aerobique to miniti 75 ya mosala ya makasi ya aerobique mposo nyonso.

src: You should also do muscle-strengthening activities at least twice a week.
trg: Osengeli mpe kosala misala ya kolendisa misisa soki moke mbala mibale na mposo.

src: When you make healthy choices for your health and fitness, you are not only improving your own life, but you are also setting a positive example for others.
trg: Soki ozali kosala maponi ya malamu mpo na santé mpe kolongono na yo, ozali kaka te kobongisa bomoi na yo, kasi ozali mpe kopesa ndakisa ya malamu epai ya bato mosusu.

src: By making healthy choices, you are helping to create a healthier community and a healthier world.
trg: Soki ozali kosala maponi ya malamu, ozali kosalisa na kosala communauté ya malamu mpe mokili ya malamu.

src: The most recent major news event in Eritrea was the 2018 Eritrean–Ethiopian peace agreement.
trg: Nsango ya ntina mingi ya kala mingi te ya Érythrée ezalaki boyokani ya kimya ya 2018 kati ya Érythrée na Ethiopie.

src: This agreement ended a 20-year war between the two countries and resulted in the reopening of borders and the resumption of trade.
trg: Boyokani wana esukisaki bitumba ya mibu 20 kati ya bamboka mibale wana mpe esalaki ete bafungola bandelo mpe bazongela mombongo.

src: It was a significant step forward for regional stability and peace.
trg: Ezalaki etambe ya ntina mpo na stabilité mpe kimya ya eteni wana.

src: Another recent development is the 2019 Eritrean presidential election.
trg: Likambo mosusu ya ntina ya kala mingi te ezalaki maponi ya prezida ya Érythrée na 2019.

src: Isaias Afwerki, who has been president of Eritrea since 1993, was re-elected for a fifth term with 99% of the vote.
trg: Isaias Afwerki, oyo azalaki prezida ya Érythrée banda 1993, bavotaki ye lisusu mpo na koyangela mbala ya mitano na 99% ya bavote.

src: The election was widely criticized by international observers as not being free or fair.
trg: Batali ya mokili mobimba elobaki mabe mpo na maponi wana, balobaki ezali ya bonsomi te mpe ya boyengebene te.

src: In addition to these major events, there have also been a number of smaller news stories in Eritrea over the past few years.
trg: Longola makambo wana ya ntina, ezali mpe na masolo mingi ya sika ya mike na Érythrée na mwa bamvula euti koleka.

src: These include the 2016 closure of the United Nations office in Eritrea, the 2017 release of several political prisoners, and the 2018 visit of Pope Francis to the country.
trg: Makambo ezali kokangama ya biro ya Nations-Unies na Érythrée na 2016, kobimisa bato mingi ya politiki na boloko na 2017, mpe ndenge Pape François akendaki kotala mboka wana na 2018.

src: Overall, the past few years have been a period of relative stability and progress for Eritrea.
trg: Na mokuse, mwa bambula eleki ezalaki eleko ya mwa kimya mpe ya bokoli na Érythrée.

src: The country has made significant steps towards peace and reconciliation with its neighbors, and there have been some positive developments on the human rights front.
trg: Mboka ekei mpenza liboso na makambo ya kimya mpe koyokana na bamboka ya pene, mpe ezalaki na mwa bokoli na makambo ya balotomo ya bato.

src: The distribution of beauty services and spas is changing, with a growing number of men seeking out these services.
trg: Kokabola misala ya bonzenga mpe ya spas ezali kobongwana, mpe mibale ebele bazali koluka misala oyo.

src: In the United States, the number of male spa-goers has increased by 30% in the past five years, and men now account for 20% of all spa visits.
trg: Na États-Unis, motango ya mibali oyo bakendaka na spa emata na 30% na mibu mitano euti koleka, mpe sikoyo mibale bazali 20% ya bato oyo bakendaka na spa.

src: This trend is being driven by a number of factors, including the increasing awareness of the benefits of self-care, the growing popularity of men's grooming products, and the rise of social media, which has made it more acceptable for men to talk about their beauty routines.
trg: Ezali na makambo ebele oyo ezali komema likambo oyo, neti komata ya koyeba matomba ya komisalela bonzenga, bato mingi bazali kosepela na bankisi ya monzele ya mibale, mpe komata ya reseaux sociaux, oyo esalisa mibale na komona ete ezali mabe te kolobela bizaleli na bango ya bonzenga.

src: As the demand for male beauty services grows, spas are starting to cater more specifically to men's needs.
trg: Lokola bosengi ya misala ya bonzenga ya mibali ezali komata, spa ebandi kokipe mingimingi bamposa ya mibali.

src: This includes offering a wider range of services, such as beard trims and massages, as well as creating a more masculine environment.
trg: Yango etali misala ya ndenge na ndenge, neti kokata mandefu, masage, mpe kosalisa esika oyo ebongi mpenza mpo na mibali.

src: Some spas are even offering men-only days or hours, so that men can feel comfortable getting pampered without feeling self-conscious.
trg: Ba spa misusu ezali kutu na mikolo to bangonga ya mibali mpamba, mpo mibali bamiyoka malamu ntango bazali kokipe bango kozanga bamiyeba.

src: The growth of the male beauty market is a sign of a changing attitude towards men's grooming.
trg: Bokoli ya zando ya bonzenga ya mibali ezali elembo ya mbogwana ya makanisi ya monzele ya mibali.

src: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.
trg: Mwa robin ya moke azalaki kopumbwa na zamba ntango amonaki etuluku ya bandeke basangani na nzete moko ya monene.

src: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.
trg: Akweaki na etape moko ya pene mpe ayokaki makambo bazalaki koloba.

src: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.
trg: "Bazali kolandela biso na nzete oyo banda bamposo ebele," wana maloba ya yanganga.

src: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.
trg: "Toyebi te nini ezali kosala ete etengama na ndenge wana ya likama!" wana maloba yya alikilikoso ya moke.

src: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.
trg: "Kasi tozali komitungisa ete ekokwea mpe ekosala moto mabe!" wana ndenge mpongo agangaki.

src: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.
trg: Robin atalaki nzete mpe amonaki ete etengamaki mpenza makasi na ngambo moko.

src: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.
trg: Ayebaki ete asengeli kosala eloko mpo na kosalisa, kasi ayebaki te nini asengeli kosala.

src: Suddenly, an idea came to him.
trg: Na mbala moko, likanisi moko eyelaki ye.

src: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.
trg: Akitaki na mabele mpe asangisaki malili ebele mpenza.

src: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.
trg: Na nsima apumbwaki lisusu likolo ya nzete mpe abandaki kokotisa matiti na libulu esika misisa ezalaki komonana.

src: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.
trg: Bandeke na nse bazalaki kotala na kokamwa ntango robin azalaki kosala.

src: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.
trg: Bazalaki kondima te ete ndeke wana ya moke ekoki kozala na makasi ebele ndenge wana.

src: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.
trg: Nsima ya mwa bangonga, robin asilisaki kotondisa libulu wana nyonso.

src: The tree was now standing upright and stable.
trg: Nzete etelemaki alima mpe malamu.

src: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.
trg: Bandeko mosusu bakumisaka robin mpe bapesaki ye botondi mpo abikisaki bango.

src: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
trg: Mokili ezali esika ya kokesana mpenza na ndenge ezalaki mwa bambula eleki.

src: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.
trg: Bolingo ya ekolo ekota na bamboka ebele, mpe bato bakabwana na ndenge ya koleka mpenza.

src: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.
trg: Na mboka moko, etuluku moko ya bato balingaka mboka bakoma koyangela mboka mpe bazali kosalela bokonzi na bango mpo na koboma batomboki.

src: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.
trg: Bakanga lolenge nyonso ya bapanzi-nsango oyo bamoni ete "balingaka mboka te," mpe bakanga mpe baboma kutu bato oyo batelemelaka guvernema.

src: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.
trg: Mokolo moko, elenge mwasi moko nkombo na ye Rebecca azali kozonga na ndako nsima ya eteyelo mpe etuluku moko ya basoda oyo balingaka mboka batelemisi ye.

src: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.
trg: Bafundi ye ete azali monguna, mpe bamemi na boloko moko ya nkuku.

src: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.
trg: Banyokoli Rebecca mpe batuni ye mituna ebele, kasi aboyi kopesa nsango ata moko.

src: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.
trg: Nsima ya bamposo ebele, nsukansuka Rebecca abimi na boloko.

src: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.
trg: Azali ya kolemba mpe alyaka malamu te, kasi azali na mokano ya kobundisa bato wana oyo balingaka ekolo.

src: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.
trg: Asangani na etuluku ya batelemeli, mpe akomi moto ya ntina mingi mpo na mosala wana.

src: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.
trg: Rebecca asalelaka mayele ya teknolozi mpo na kosalisa batelemeli na kosolola mpi kobongisa bitumba na bango.

src: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.
trg: Asalelaka mpe mayele na ye lokola pirate mpo na kokota na baordinatere ya bato balingaka mboka mpe koyiba bansango na bango.

src: Vast archives of military photos have been digitized and made available online, allowing researchers to study them from anywhere in the world.
trg: Bafoto ya kala ya basoda oyo baboma bakotisa yango na ordinatere mpe bato bakoki komona yango na internet, epesa balukilui nzela ya koyeba yango longwa na esika nyonso na mokili.

src: This has led to a number of new discoveries, as researchers are able to compare photos from different sources and identify previously unknown individuals.
trg: Esalisa na komona biloko ebele ya sika, mpo balukiluki bakoki kokokanisa bafoto euti na bisika ekeseni mpe koyeba bato oyo bayebaki nanu te.

src: In one case, researchers were able to identify a soldier who had been missing for over 70 years using photos from a military archive.
trg: Na ndakisa moko, balukiluki bayebaki soda moko oyo azangaki na boumeli ya mibu 70 na kosalelaka bafoto ya biloko ya kala ya basoda.

src: The soldier's family was overjoyed to finally learn what had happened to him, and they were able to hold a proper funeral for him.
trg: Libota ya soda wana esepelaki na koyeba nsukansuka makambo oyo ekomelaki ye, mpe basalaka matanga ebongi mpo na ye.

src: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
trg: Maloba ya ntoki ezali lokota ya mokili mobimba ekatisaka ntango mpe bisika.

src: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
trg: Ekoki kosalelama mpo na kobimisa mayoki, kobeta masolo, mpe kolobela makanisi ya mindondo.

src: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
trg: Lokola mobongoli, nazali na libaku ya kosalisa na komema maloba ya ntoki na bato ya sika na kobongolaka yango na lokota mosusu.

src: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
trg: Ezali mosala ya mpasi kasi ya kitoko, mpo nasengeli kaka te kobalola maloba ya ntoki liloba na liloba, kasi nasengeli kobakisa kitoko na nguya na yango.

src: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
trg: Moko ya makambo ya ntina ya kotalela ntango ozali kobongola maloba ya ntoki ezali rythme na molai na yango.

src: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
trg: Biloko oyo ezali ntina mpo na kitoko ya maloba ya ntoki, mpe ekoki kozala mpasi na kobimisa yango na lokota mosusu.

src: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
trg: Na bandakisa mosusu, ekoki kosenga bachanger rythm to molai na yango mwa moke mpo na maloba ya ntoki elobama kitoko na lokota nazali kobongola.

src: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
trg: Kasi, nasalaka nyonso mpo na kobatela ndimbola mpe mokano ya ebandeli ya maloba ya ntoki.

src: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
trg: Eloko mosusu ya ntina ya kotalela ezali kosalela maloba ya elilingi.

src: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
trg: Mbala mingi bapoete basalelaka bametaphore, bokokanisi, mpe maloba mosusu ya elilingi mpo na kosala bafoto ya makasi mpe kobakisa mozindo na mosala na bango.

src: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
trg: Ntango nazali kobongola biloko oyo, nasengeli kozwa na lokota nazali kobongola maloba ebongi oyo ekozala na bopusi ya ndenge moko epai ya batangi.

src: Dolls and doll accessories are a popular way for children to play and learn.
trg: Bana ya popi mpe biloko ya bana ya popi ezali lolenge eyebana oyo bana basakanaka mpe bayekolaka.

src: Dolls can represent people, animals, or even imaginary creatures.
trg: Bana ya popi emonisaka bato, banyama, to kutu bikelamu oyo ezalaka te.

src: They can be dressed up in different clothes, given different furniture to play with, and placed in different settings.
trg: Bakoki kolatisa bango bilamba ekeseni, kopesa bango biloko ekeseni ya kosakana na yango, mpe kotya bango na bisika ekeseni.

src: Children can use dolls to act out stories, explore different roles, and learn about the world around them.
trg: Bana bakoki kosalela bana ya popi mpo na kobeta masolo, komeka mikumba ekeseni, mpe koyekola makambo ya mokili ezinga bango.

src: For example, a child might use a doll to pretend to be a doctor, a teacher, or a firefighter.
trg: Na ndakisa, mwana akoki kosalela mwana ya popi mpo na komeka kosala neti azali monganga, molakisi, to moto abomaka moto.

src: It's not just about what you wear, but how you wear it.
trg: Ezali te kaka oyo olataka, kasi ndenge olataka yango.

src: If you're always slouching and your clothes are rumpled, it shows that you don't care about yourself.
trg: Soki ozali ntango nyonso ya kolemba mpe bilamba na yo ezali ya kofinafina, ezolakisa ete omikipaka te.

src: People will notice and they'll make assumptions about you.
trg: Bato bakomona yango mpe bakozwela yo makanisi.

src: They might think that you're lazy or unkempt.
trg: Bakoki kokanisa ete ozali goigoi to basundola yo.

src: They might even think that you're not a good person.
trg: Bakoki kutu kokanisa ete ozali te moto ya malamu.

src: Of course, there are times when we all wear shabby clothes.
trg: Ya solo, ezali na bantango oyo biso nyonso tolataka bilamba ya malamu te.

src: Maybe we're just running errands or we're doing chores around the house.
trg: Mbala mosusu tozali kaka kotambola na kartie to tozali kosala misala na ndako.

src: But if you find yourself wearing shabby clothes all the time, it's time to take a look at yourself.
trg: Kasi soki ozali kolata ntango nyonso bilamba ya malamu te, oyo ntango ya komitalela.

src: Are you really happy with the way you look?
trg: Osepelaka mpenza na ndenge omonanaka?

src: If not, then it's time to make a change.
trg: Soki osepelaka na yango te, oyo ntango ya kobongwana.

src: Start by taking some time to think about your personal style.
trg: Banda na kozwa ntango ya kokanisa modele na yo moko.

src: What kind of clothes do you feel good in?
trg: Osepelaka soki olati bilamba ya ndenge nini?

src: What kind of clothes make you feel confident?
trg: Bilamba ya ndenge esalaka ete omityela motema?

src: Once you know what you like, start shopping for clothes that fit your personality.
trg: Soki oyebi oyo olingaka, banda kosomba bilamba oyo ekokani na bomoto na yo.

src: It's also important to make sure that your clothes are clean and well-fitting.
trg: Ezali mpe ntina na kosala nyonso ete bilamba na yo ezala ya peto mpe ebongi.

src: If they're rumpled or stained, it will only make you look worse.
trg: Soki ezali ya kofinafina to na batache, ekosala kaka ete obima mabe koleka.

src: Take the time to iron your clothes and make sure they fit properly.
trg: Zwa ntango ya ko repasser bilamba na yo mpe keba ete ekoka yo malamu.

src: Finally, don't be afraid to experiment with different styles.
trg: Na nsuka, kobanga na komeka midele mosusu.

src: You might be surprised at what you find.
trg: Okoki kokamwa na makambo okomona.

src: There are so many different ways to dress, so don't be afraid to try new things.
trg: Ezali na balolenge ebele ekeseni ya kolata, yango wana kobanga te na komeka biloko ya sika.

src: The more you experiment, the more likely you are to find a style that you love.
trg: Soki ozali komeka bilamba ebele, okozala na mabaku ebele ya kozwa modele oyo okolinga.

src: When you dress well, it shows that you take pride in yourself.
trg: Soki olati malamu, ekolakisa ete opesaka lokumu.

src: It also makes you feel more confident.
trg: Esalaka mpe ete omityela motema mingi.

src: So if you're looking for a way to boost your self-confidence, start by taking a look at your wardrobe.
trg: Yango wana soki ozali koluka ndenge ya kobanda komityela motema mingi, banda na kotala bilamba na yo.

src: A few new clothes can make a big difference.
trg: Mwa bilamba ya sika ekoki kosala bokeseni ya monene.

src: Ghana is a country with a rich and diverse culture, and its traditional customs are a major part of that.
trg: Ghana ezali mboka oyo ezali na bonkoko mingi mpe ekeseni, mpe mimeseno na bango ezali eteni na yango ya monene.

src: One of the most important customs is the naming ceremony, which is held for a newborn child.
trg: Moko ya mimeseno ya ntina molulu ya kopesa mwana nkombo, oyo basalaka mpo na mwana auti kobotama.

src: The ceremony is typically presided over by a traditional priest or elder, and it involves the naming of the child, as well as prayers and blessings for the child's future.
trg: Molulu wana ekambamaka na nganga-nzambe to na nkulutu, mpe ezalaki na makambo neti kopesa mwana nkombo, mabondeli mpe mapamboli mpo na avenire ya mwana.

src: Another important custom is the funeral ceremony, which is held for a deceased person.
trg: Momeseno mosusu ya ntina ezali molulu ya bokundi, oyo esalemaka mpo na moto oyo akufi.

src: The ceremony is typically very elaborate and involves music, dancing, and food.
trg: Molulu wana ezalaka ya mindondo mpe ezalaka na miziki, mabina, mpe bilei.

src: The deceased person is typically buried with their belongings, and a shrine is often built in their honor.
trg: Bakundaka moto oyo akufi mbala mingi na biloko na ye, mpe batongaka mwa sanctuaire to esika mosantu mpo na lokumu na ye.

src: Ghana is also home to a number of traditional festivals, such as the Odwira festival, which is held in the Ashanti region.
trg: Ghana ezali mpe na bafeti ebele ya bonkoko, neti feti ya Odwira, oyo basalaka na etuka ya Ashanti.

src: The festival is a time for celebration and thanksgiving, and it involves traditional music, dancing, and food.
trg: Feti ezali ntango ya esengo mpe ya kopesa matondi, mpe ezalaka na miziki, mabina, mpe bilei ya mboka.

src: In recent years, some traditional customs in Ghana have been adapted to modern life.
trg: Na mibu euti koleka, bakotisa mimeseno mosusu ya kala na Ghana na bomoi ya mikolo oyo.

src: For example, some naming ceremonies now include electronic devices such as computers and projectors.
trg: Na ndakisa, milulu mosusu ya kopesa bana nkombo ezalaka na ba aparei neti ba ordinatere mpe ba projecteur.

src: This allows for the ceremony to be more interactive and engaging for the participants.
trg: Esalisaka mpo bato oyo bayei na molulu bamikotisa mpe molulu yango esepelisa bango.

src: Overall, traditional customs in Ghana are a major part of the country's culture, and they continue to be practiced today.
trg: Na mokuse, mimeseno ya bonkoko na Ghana ezali eteni ya ntina mingi ya bonkoko na bango, mpe bakobaka kotosa yango kino lelo.

src: Klaus was a heavy smoker.
trg: Klaus azalaki momeli-monene ya makaya.

src: He smoked a pack of cigarettes a day, and he had been doing so for over 20 years.
trg: Azalaki komela pake ya makaya na mokolo moko, mpe azalaki kosala bongo banda mibu koleka 20.

src: He knew that smoking was bad for his health, but he couldn't seem to quit.
trg: Ayebaki ete komela makaya ezali mabe mpo na kolongono ya nzoto na ye, kasi azalaki kokota te kotika yango.

src: One day, Klaus was walking down the street when he saw a strange man.
trg: Mokolo moko, Klaus azalaki kotambola na balabala mpe amonaki moto moko ya kokamwa.

src: The man was wearing a long white coat and had a strange device in his hand.
trg: Moto wana alataki kazaka ya molai ya mpembe mpe azalaki na aparei ya kokamwa na loboko.

src: "Excuse me," Klaus said. "What are you doing?"
trg: "Limbisa nga," wana maloba ya Klaus. "Ozali kosala nini?"

src: "I'm a scientist," the man said. "I'm working on a new device that will help people quit smoking."
trg: "Nazali moto ya siansi," wana maloba ya mobali wana. "Nazali kosala aparei ya sika oyo ekosalisa bato na kotika komela makaya."

src: "Really?" Klaus said "That's amazing!"
trg: "Solo?" wana maloba ya Klaus "Ezali malamu mpenza!"

src: "Yes, it is," the man said.
trg: "Ee, ezali bongo," wana maloba ya moto yango.

src: "This device will send you to another space where you will be able to see the effects of smoking on your health."
trg: "Aparei wana ekotinda yo na esika mosusu epai wapi akozala na makoki ya komona bopusi mabe ya makaya na kolongono ya nzoto na yo."

src: "That sounds incredible," Klaus said. "I'd like to try it."
trg: "Nakoki kondima yango te," wana eyano ya Klaus. "Nakosepela komeka yango."

src: The man smiled. "Very well," he said. "Just step into this device and I'll start the process."
trg: Moto wana asekaki. "Ezali malamu," wana maloba na ye. "Kota kaka na kati ya aparei ebongi nakobanda mosala."

src: Klaus stepped into the device and the man closed the door behind him.
trg: Klaus akotaki na kati ya aparei wana mpe moto wana akangaki porte na nsima na ye.

src: It was a beautiful day for a picnic, so my family and I decided to go to the park.
trg: Ezalaki mokolo ya kitoko mpo na pique-nique, yango wana libota na nga ezwaki ekateli ya kokende na parke.

src: We packed a lunch and set out early in the morning.
trg: Tobongisaki bilei ya midi mpe tokendaki na ntongo makasi.

src: When we got to the park, we found a nice spot to spread out our blanket and eat our lunch.
trg: Ntango tokomaki na parke, tomonaki esika ya kitoko ya kotanda bulangeti na biso mpe ya kolya.

src: We had sandwiches, chips, fruit, and cookies.
trg: Tozalaki na basandwishe, bachipes, bambuma, mpe babiscuit.

src: After we ate, we played some games and just enjoyed spending time together.
trg: Nsima ya kolya, tosalaki mwa masano mpe tosepelaki kolekisa ngonga elongo.

src: We didn't think about anything except having fun.
trg: Tokanisaki na eloko mosusu te longola kaka kosepela.

src: It was a perfect day.
trg: Ezalaki mokolo ya malamu mpenza.

src: This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a central location in Lisbon.
trg: Hotele oyo ezali liponi ya malamu mpo na bato oyo bazali koluka esika ya katikati na Lisbon.

src: It is located just a short walk from the city center and the waterfront, and it offers stunning views of the port.
trg: Ezali mosika te na makolo na katikati ya engumba mpe mbu, mpe ezalaki na bisika ya kitoko mpenza ya kotala libongo.

src: The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
trg: Bachambre ezali minene mpe ebongi, mpe basali bazali boboto mpe basungaka mpenza.

src: The hotel is also very quiet, which is ideal for those who want to get a good night's sleep.
trg: Hotele ezali mpenza kimya, mpe ebongi mpo na bato oyo balingaka kolala malamu na butu.

src: The rooms are soundproofed, and the hotel is located in a quiet area away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
trg: Makelele ekotaka te na bachambre, mpe hotele ezali na esika ya kimya mosika na makelele mpe mobulu ya katikati ya engumba.

src: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
trg: Kozongisa biloko ya sika ezali mayele ya ntina oyo esalisaka na kobatela mopepe mpe biloko ya bozalisi.

src: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
trg: Soki tozali kosongisa biloko ya sika, tokoki kokitsa mingi ya mbindo oyo ekendaka na bisika babwakaka mbindo mpe bizikisaka yango, kobatea energie mpe mbongo.

src: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
trg: Metode oyo ya kozongisa biloko ya sika ebanda na kosangisa biloko oyo basalelaka mbala ebele.

src: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
trg: Bakoki kopona biloko oyo mpe kotya yango na molongo ya biloko oyo bakoki kosalela mpo na kosala biloko ya sika.

src: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.
trg: Na ndakisa, bakoki kosalela milangi ya kopale oyo basalela mpo na kosala milangi ya sika ya kopale, bakoki kosalela manzanza ya aliminium oyo basalela mpo na kosala manzanza ya sika ya aliminium, mpe bakoki kosalela bapapie basalela mpo na kosala bapapie ya sika.

src: Recycling has many benefits.
trg: Kozongisa biloko na mosala ezali na matomba ebele.

src: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
trg: Esalisaka na kokitisa mingi ya mbindo oyo ekendaka na bisika babwaka biloko mpe bazikisaka yango, ebongo esalisaka na kobatela mopepe mpe biloko ya bozalisi.

src: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
trg: Kozongisa biloko ya sika ebatelaka mpe energie, mpo esengaka energie moke mpo na kosala biloko longwa na biloko oyo basalela koleka soki basali yango longwa na biloko ya sika.

src: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
trg: Lisusu, kozongisa biloko ya sika ebatelaka mbongo, mpo ekotisaka mposa ya kobimisa mpe kosalela biloko ya sika.

src: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
trg: Kobima ya baprograme ya sika ya kozongisa biloko ya sika na mikili ebele esukisa ebongiseli ya kozongisa biloko ya sika ya kode ya langi.

src: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
trg: Ezali bongo mpo basala baprograme ya sika mpo endima kozongisa sika biloko oyo basalela, ata ezali na langi nini.

src: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
trg: Baprograme ya sika ezali mpe malamu mingi, mpo esalelaka bibongiseli ya automatike ya kosangisa biloko mpo na biloko oyo bakoki kosalela lisusu.

src: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.
trg: Bafololo ezalaki ntalo mingi, kasi nazalaki kokipe te.

src: I had to have them.
trg: Esengelaki nazala na yango.

src: They were the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen, and I knew they would make her happy.
trg: Ezalaki bafololo ya koleka kitoko oyo natikala komona nanu te, mpe nayebaki ete ekopesa ye esengo.

src: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.
trg: Nasombaka barose zomi na mibale, nyonso ya balangi ekeseni.

src: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.
trg: Nabongisaki yango na sani moko mpe natyaki yango na mesa pene ya mbeto.

src: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."
trg: Asekaki ntango amonaki yango. "Ezali kitoko," wana maloba na ye. "Matondi."

src: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.
trg: Nasekaki mpe. "Likambo te." Nafandaki pene na mbeto na ye mpe nasimbaki loboko na ye.

src: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.
trg: Atalaki nga na miso na ye ya minene ya brun.

src: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.
trg: "Nasepeli mingi ndenge ozali awa," wana maloba na ye. "Nasepeli mpo ozali mpe awa," wana maloba na nga.

src: We talked for a long time.
trg: Tosololaki bangonga ebele.

src: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.
trg: Tolobelaki bandoto na biso, bilikya na biso, mpe makambo ebangisaka biso.

src: We talked about the future.
trg: Tolobelaki mikolo ezali koya.

src: When it was time for me to go, she gave me a hug.
trg: Ntango ngonga ya kokende ekokaki, apesaki nga lipwepwe.

src: "Thank you for coming," she said. "I love you."
trg: "Matondi ndenge oyaki," wana maloba na ye. "Nalingaka yo."

src: "I love you too," I said.
trg: "Nalingaka yo mpe," wana maloba na nga.

src: I kissed her on the forehead and then I left.
trg: Napesaki ye beze na mbunzu mpe akendaki.

src: Cork flooring is a popular choice for many homeowners because it is durable, stylish, and easy to maintain.
trg: Plancher ya liège ezali liponi oyo bankolo mingi ya bandako basalaka mpo eumelaka, ezali kitoko, mpe ezali pete na kobatela.

src: However, it is important to know how to properly care for cork flooring in order to extend its lifespan and keep it looking its best.
trg: Kasi, ezali ntina koyeba ndenge ya kobatela malamu plancher ya liège mpo eumela mingi mpe emonana ntango nyonso kaka kitoko.

src: One of the most important things you can do to care for your cork flooring is to sweep, dust, or vacuum it regularly.
trg: Moko ya makambo ya ntina okoki kosala mpo na kobatela plancher na yo ya liège ezali kokombola yango, kolongola yango putulu mpe kolekisa yango aspirateur mbala na mbala.

src: This will help to remove dirt and debris that can build up on the surface of the flooring and cause it to become damaged.
trg: Ekosalisa na kolongola mbindo mpe biloko ekwea oyo ekoki kotikala likolo na yango mpe ekosala ete ebeba.

src: If you have pets, it is especially important to vacuum your cork flooring regularly to remove pet hair and dander.
trg: Soki ozali na banyama, ezali ntina mingi na kolekisa aspirateur na plancher na yo ya liège mbala na mbala mpo na kolongola nsuki ya banyama mpe dander.

src: In addition to sweeping, dusting, or vacuuming, you should also occasionally wipe your cork flooring with a damp mop.
trg: Longola kokombola, kolongola putulu to kolekisa aspirateur, osengeli mpe bantango mosusu kolekisa mope ya mai mingi te likolo ya plancher na yo ya liège.

src: This will help to remove any dirt or grime that has been missed by the vacuum cleaner.
trg: Ekosalisa na kolongola mbindo nyonso oyo aspirateur ekokaki te kolongola.

src: However, it is important to use a damp mop and not a wet mop, as too much water can damage the cork flooring.
trg: Kasi, ezali ntina na kosalela mope ya mai mingi te kasi te mope ya mai, mpo soki mai ezali ebele ekoki kobebisa plancher ya liège.

src: If you have any spills on your cork flooring, it is important to clean them up as soon as possible.
trg: Soki ezali na basupu likolo ya plancher na yo ya liège, ezali ntina kosukola yango kozanga kozela.

src: Use a clean cloth to blot up the spill and then wipe the area with a damp mop.
trg: Salela elamba ya peto mpo na kolongola supu wana mpe na nsima pangusa esika mana na mope ya mai mingi te.

src: If the spill is sticky, you may need to use a mild detergent to clean it up.
trg: Soki supu ekangami makasi, mbala mosusu esengeli osalela detergent ya makasi te mpo na kosokola yango.

src: It is also important to protect your cork flooring from scratches and dents.
trg: Ezali mpe ntina na kobatela plancher na yo ya liège mpo ekoma te na banzela mpe bisika evimbi.

src: To do this, you can place felt pads under furniture legs and avoid dragging heavy objects across the floor.
trg: Mpo na kosala yango, okoki kotya ba coussin ya feutre na makolo ya bakiti to bamesa mpe kobenda te biloko ya kilo likolo ya ciment.

src: You should also avoid using sharp objects on your cork flooring, as this can damage the surface.
trg: Osengeli koboya kosalela biloko ezali mpya likolo ya plancher na yo ya liège, mpo ekoki kobebisa yango.

src: By following these tips, you can help to keep your cork flooring looking its best for years to come.
trg: Soki osaleli batoli oyo, okoki kosalisa na kobatela plancher na yo ya liège mpo ezali kitoko na eleko ya bambula ebele.

src: In addition to the tips above, there are a few other things you can do to care for your cork flooring.
trg: Longola batoli tolobeli na likolo, ezali na makambo mosusu okoki kosala mpo na kobatela plancher na yo ya liège.

src: First, avoid using harsh chemicals on your cork flooring, as these can damage the surface.
trg: Ya liboso, kosalela te biloko ya chimie ya makasi likolo ya plancher na yo ya liège, mpo ekoki kobebisa yango.

src: Second, do not expose your cork flooring to direct sunlight for long periods of time, as this can cause the color to fade.
trg: Ya mibale, kotika te plancher na yo ya liège na nse ya moi na eleko ya molai ya ntango, mpo ekoki kosala ete enzuluka.

src: Finally, if you are planning to move your furniture around, be careful not to drag it across the floor, as this can also damage the surface.
trg: Ya nsuka, soki ozali kokana kotya biloko ya ndako esika mosusu, zala mayele kobenda yango te na likolo ya ciment, mpo ekoki kobebisa yango.

src: By following these tips, you can help to extend the life of your cork flooring and keep it looking its best for years to come.
trg: Soki osaleli batoli oyo, okoki kosalisa na kobakisa boumeli ya plancher na yo ya liège mpe kosalisa mpo ezala kaka kitoko na bambula ezali koya.

src: Refrigerators and freezers are essential appliances for keeping food and beverages fresh.
trg: Bafrigo na bacongelateur ezalaka biloko ya ntina mpo na kobatela bilei mpe masanga na malili.

src: The refrigerant then passes through the condenser coils, where it releases the heat to the outside air * Thermostat: This controls the temperature inside the refrigerator and freezer.
trg: Na nsima refrigerant elekaka na babobine ya condensateur, esika ebimisaka moto na mopepe ya libanda * Thermostat: Elandelaka temperature na kati ya frigo mpe ya congelateur.

src: The total amount of heat that a refrigerator or freezer can remove from its contents is called the cooling capacity.
trg: Motango mobimba ya moto oyo frigo to congelateur ekoki kolongola banda na biloko na yango babengaka yango makoki ya kokomisa malili.

src: The cooling capacity is measured in British thermal units (BTUs) per hour.
trg: Bamekaka makoki ya kokomisa biloko malili na unité ya thermique ya Grande-Bretagne (BTUs) na ngonga.

src: Refrigerators and freezers are typically rated by their total cooling capacity.
trg: Bafrigo na bacongelateur basalaka evaluation na kotelala makoki na yango ya kokomisa malili.

src: The history of Burkina Faso is long and complex, but one of the most important events in the country's history was the 1983 coup d'état that brought Thomas Sankara to power.
trg: Lisolo ya Burkina Faso ezali ya molai mpe ya mindondo, kasi moko ya makambo ya ntina mingi ya lisolo ya ekolo oyo ezalaki coup d'etat ya 1983 oyo ememaki Thomas Sankara na bokonzi.

src: Sankara was a young military officer who was deeply committed to social justice and economic development.
trg: Sankara azalaki mokonzi moko ya basoda ya elenge oyo amipesaki mingi na kozanga boyengebene ya sociale mpe na kokolisa ekonomi.

src: He quickly implemented a series of radical reforms, including nationalizing banks and industry, redistributing land, and promoting women's rights.
trg: Abandaki noki kobongola makambo ebele ata kokomisa babanke mpe bakompani ezala ya mboka, kokabola lisusu mabele, mpe kotombola balotomo ya basi.

src: Sankara's policies were popular with many Burkinabés, but they also alienated powerful interests, both within the country and abroad.
trg: Bato mingi ya Burkina Faso basepelaki na mayele ya Sankara, kasi ebebisaka matomba ya bato ya makasi, ya mboka mpe ya bapaya.

src: In 1987, Sankara was assassinated in a coup d'état led by Blaise Compaoré.
trg: Na 1987, babomaki Sankara na coup d'état oyo ekambamaki na Blaise Compaoré.

src: Compaoré ruled Burkina Faso for 27 years, during which time he reversed many of Sankara's reforms and established a repressive authoritarian regime.
trg: Compaoré ayangelaki Burkina Faso mibu 27, na eleko wana alongolaki mbongwana ebele oyo Sankara asalaki mpe atyaki boyangeli ya nkanza oyo enyokolaki bato.

src: In 2014, Compaoré was overthrown in a popular uprising, and Burkina Faso is currently in a fragile state of transition.
trg: Na 2014, bakweisaki Compaoré na botomboki ya bato nyonso, mpe Burkina Faso ezali sikoyo na eleko ya transition mpe ezali makasi te.

src: Despite the challenges it faces, Burkina Faso has a long history of resilience and progress.
trg: Ata ezali kokutana na bampasi, Burkina Faso ezali na lisolo ya moali ya kolendendela mpe ya kokende liboso.

src: The country has a rich culture and a strong sense of national identity.
trg: Mboka oyo ezali na culture ya monene mpe mayoki makasi ya identité ya mboka.

src: Burkinabés are a proud people who are determined to build a better future for themselves and their children.
trg: Bato ya Burkina Faso bazali bato ya lolendo oyo bamipesa na kobongisa avenire ya malamu mpo na bango moko mpe mpo na bana na bango.

src: As the sun began to set, a young boy named Raman made his way home from school.
trg: Ntango moi ebandi kodinda, elenge mobali moko nkombo na ye Raman azongaki ndako nsima ya kelasi.

src: As he walked, he noticed a stray dog following him.
trg: Ntango azalaki kotambola, amonaki mbwa ebungi ezali kolanda ye.

src: The dog was dirty and skinny, but it had a friendly face.
trg: Mbwa wana ezalaki mbindo mpe nzoto mike, kasi ezalaki na elongi ya malamu.

src: Raman felt sorry for the dog, so he decided to take it home with him.
trg: Raman ayokelaka mbwa wana mawa, yango wana azwaki ekateli ya komema yango na ndako.

src: When Raman got home, he told his parents about the dog.
trg: Ntango Raman akomaki na ndako, ayebisaki baboti na ye lisolo ya mbwa wana.

src: They were hesitant at first, but they eventually agreed to let him keep the dog.
trg: Na ebandeli basepelaki te, kasi nsukansuka bandimaka kopesa ye nzela ya kobatela mbwa wana.

src: Raman named the dog Buddy, and they quickly became best friends.
trg: Raman apesaka mbwa wana nkombo Buddy, mpe kala mingi te bakomaki baninga ya makasi.

src: Buddy was always there for Raman, no matter what.
trg: Buddy azalaki ntango nyonso pene mpo na Raman, ata likambo nini esalemi.

src: He was there to greet him at the door when he came home from school, and he was there to comfort him when he was feeling down.
trg: Azalaki wana mpo na kopesa ye mbote na porte ntango azalaki kozonga na ndako nsima ya kelasi, mpe azalaki wana mpo na kobondisa ye soki azali komiyoka mabe.

src: One day, Raman was playing in the park when he fell and scraped his knee.
trg: Mokolo moko, Raman azalaki kosakana na parke ebongo akweaki mpe azokaki na libolongo.

src: He started to cry, and Buddy came running over to lick his wound.
trg: Abandaki kolela, mpe Buddy ayaki mbango kolembola mpota na ye.

src: The dog's gentle tongue helped to soothe Raman's pain, and he soon forgot all about his injury.
trg: Lolemo ya boboto ya mbwa esalisaki na kokitisa mpasi ya Raman, mpe abosanaki noki mpota na ye.

src: Raman and Buddy shared many happy years together.
trg: Raman na Buddy balekisa bambula ebele ya esengo elongo.

src: They went on walks, played fetch in the park, and cuddled up on the couch together.
trg: Bakenda kotambola, kosakana na parke, mpe balala elongo na kiti ya monene.

src: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
trg: Kompani ya bafilme sci-fi ekiti mingi na bambula oyo euti koleka, mpo bazali kosala bafilme moke mpenza.

src: In fact, a recent study by the Motion Picture Association of America found that the number of sci-fi films released in theaters declined from 20 in 2010 to just 10 in 2015.
trg: Ya solo, boyekoli moke esalemi na Lisanga ya Bafoto Etambolaka te ya Amerika emonaki ete motango ya bafilme oyo sci-fi ebimisi na bateyatre ekiti banda na 20 na 2010 kino na 10 mpamba na 2015.

src: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
trg: Ezali na bantina ebele ya kokita wana, neti komata ya bafilme ya superhéro mpe ndenge bato bakomi kosepela mingi na misala ya streaming.

src: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
trg: Bato bakoma kosepela mingi mpenza na bafilme ya superhéro kala mingi te, mpo na bolongi ya bakompani neti Marvel Cinematic Universe mpe DC Extended Universe.

src: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
trg: Bafilme oyo epesaka balandi bafilme ya action, ya maseki, mpe spectacle oyo mbala mingi ezalaka nde na bafilme ya sci-fi.

src: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
trg: Misala ya streaming ezali mpe na bopusi mabe na kompani ya bafilme sci-fi.

src: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
trg: Misala oyo ezalaka na makambo ya ndenge na ndenge, ata mpe bafilme ya sci-fi, na ntalo moke mpenza.

src: This makes it more difficult for sci-fi films to compete in theaters, where they are often priced at a premium.
trg: Esalaka ete ezala mpasi mingi mpo bafilme ya sci-fi ewelana na bateyatre, esika batyaka bantalo ya makasi.

src: As a result of these factors, the sci-fi movie industry is in need of a major shake-up.
trg: Mpo na makambo oyo, kompani ya bafilme sci-fi ezali na mposa ya mbongwana ya makasi.

src: Imagine being able to enjoy your life without the constant fear of these debilitating conditions.
trg: Kanisa ete azali na makoki ya kozala na bomoi kozanga kobanga mbala na mbala maladi oyo ya mpasi.

src: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.
trg: Maladi ya nzela ya kosuba (UTI) ezali maladi bato babelaka mingi, mingimingi basi.

src: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including pain, burning, and frequent urination.
trg: Ekoki kobimisa bilembo ebele, neti mpasi, kozika, mpe kosuba mbala na mbala.

src: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.
trg: Na bandakisa mosusu, UTI ekoki komema maladi ya makasi koleka, neti maladi ya rein.

src: Bladder stones are another common problem.
trg: Mabanga ya vessie ezali likambo mosusu oyo emonanaka mingi.

src: They can cause pain, difficulty urinating, and blood in the urine.
trg: Ekoki kobmisa mpasi, kosuba na mpasi, mpe makila na masuba.

src: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.
trg: Na bandakisa mosusu, mabanga ya vessie ekoki kokanga nzela ya masuba, yango ekoki kobimisa urgence oyo ekoki komema na liwa.

src: Kidney diseases are a serious problem that can affect people of all ages.
trg: Maladi ya rein ezali makambo ya mpasi oyo bato ya mbula nyonso bakoki kokutana na yango.

src: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including fatigue, nausea, and vomiting.
trg: Ezalaka na bilembo ndenge na ndenge, neti kolemba, mposa ya kosanza, mpe kosanza.

src: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.
trg: Na bandakisa mosusu, maladi ya rein ekoki komema na insuffisance ya rein, oyo ekoki komema na liwa.

src: If you are suffering from any of these conditions, there is help available.
trg: Soki ozali kobela moko ya maladi oyo, lisungi ezali.

src: Talk to your doctor about your symptoms and treatment options.
trg: Solola na monganga na yo mpo na bilembo na yo mpe bankisi oyo okoki kozwa.

src: There are a variety of treatments available for UTIs, bladder stones, and kidney diseases.
trg: Ezali na bankisi ebele mpo na UTI, mabanga ya vessie, mpe maladi ya rein.

src: With proper treatment, you can get relief from your symptoms and prevent further complications.
trg: Soki ozwi nkisi ya malamu, bilembo na yo ekoki kosila mpe ekosalisa mpo okutana na bampasi mosusu te.

src: Don't let these conditions control your life.
trg: Kotika te maladi oyo eyangela bomoi na yo.

src: Talk to your doctor today and start on the path to recovery.
trg: Solola na monganga na yo lelo mpe banda nzela ya lobiko.

src: "Ms. Smith," I said, "I'm really looking forward to the food and wine festival this weekend.
trg: "Madame Smith," nalobaki, "Nazali mpenza kozela bilei mpe vino ya feti ya wikendi oyo.

src: I've heard that the tasting events are going to be amazing."
trg: Nayokaki ete molulu ya komeka bilei ekozala kitoko makasi."

src: "Yes, they are," Ms. Smith replied.
trg: "Ee, ezali bongo," wana eyano ya Madame Smith.

src: "But be careful not to overdo it. You don't want to get too full or too tipsy!"
trg: "Kasi zala mayele, kolekisa te ndelo. Osengeli te kokende mobimba to kolangwa!"

src: "I won't," I said. "I'll just sample a few things from each booth."
trg: "Nakosala yango te," wana eyano na nga. "Nakomeka kaka mwa ndambo ya mokomoko."

src: "That's a good plan," Ms. Smith said. "And be sure to drink plenty of water to stay hydrated."
trg: "Wana miango ya malamu," wana maloba ya Madame Smith. "Mpe kobosana te na komela mai ebele mpo olemba te."

src: "I will," I said.
trg: "Nakosala yango," wana eyano na nga.

src: I arrived at the festival early and was immediately overwhelmed by the sights and smells.
trg: Nayebi na feti liboso mpe nabandaki mbala kokamwa biloko mpe bansolo nyonso oyo ezalaki.

src: There were food booths from all over the world, and the air was filled with the smoke from cooking food.
trg: Ezalaki na bisika batyaki bilei ya mokili mobimba, mpe mopepe etondaki na milinga ya bilei bazalaki kolamba.

src: I started with a sampling of cheeses from a local farm, and then moved on to a booth that was serving grilled oysters.
trg: Nabandaki na ndambo ya bafromaze ya ferme moko ya esika tofandaka, mpe na nsima nakendaki na esika bazalaki kopesa ba huitre ya kotumba.

src: The oysters were delicious, and I washed them down with a glass of crisp white wine.
trg: Ba huitre ezalaka elengi, mpe nasopelaki yango kopo moko ya vino ya mpembe ya makasi.

src: I continued to make my way around the festival, sampling everything from charcuterie to chocolate.
trg: Nakobaki kotambola na feti, mpe komeka biloko nyonso oyo ezalaki banda na charcuterie kino na chocolat.

src: The refund or exchange must be made within 14 days of purchase.
trg: Kozongisa mbongo to kozwa eloko mosusu esengeli kosalema na eleko ya mikolo 14 nsima ya kosomba.

src: The market stall credit note can be used at any of the market stalls.
trg: Bakoki kosalela biloko ya zando na bisika nyonso ya zando.

src: If the item is returned by post, the customer must return the item within 14 days of purchase and the item must be in the same condition as it was when it was purchased.
trg: Soki bozongisa eloko na nzela ya poste, kiliya asengeli kozongisa yango na eleko ya mikolo 14 ya mokolo basombaki yango mpe eloko wana esengeli kozala kaka ndenge ezalaki ntango asombaki yango.

src: The customer will then be sent a refund or exchange.
trg: Na nsima bakozongisela kiliya mbongo to kotindela ye eloko ya sika.

src: The customer is responsible for the cost of returning the item.
trg: Kiliya azali na mokumba ya depanse ya kozongisa eloko.

src: For more information, please contact the market stall manager.
trg: Mpo na koyeba makambo ebele, solola na mokambi ya eteni moko ya zando.

src: Therapist: So, you're here because you're having some conflict with your roommate.
trg: Monganga: Ozali awa mpo ozali na mwa matata na moninga na yo ya chambre.

src: Client: Yeah, it's been really tough. We're just not getting along.
trg: Kiliya: Ee, ezalaki mwa mpasi. Tozali koyokana te.

src: Therapist: Can you tell me a little bit more about what's been going on?
trg: Monganga: Okoki koyebisa nga mwa moke makambo oyo ezali kosalema?

src: Client: Well, it started a few months ago when she started taking medication for her anxiety.
trg: Kiliya: Malamu, ebandaki mwa basanza eleki ntango tobandaki kozwa bankisi mpo na basusi na ye.

src: It's like a switch flipped.
trg: Ezali neti interrupteur bafungoli.

src: She's become really irritable and short-tempered.
trg: Akomi nkandandaka mpe kosilika noki.

src: She's snapping at me all the time, and it's starting to take a toll on our relationship.
trg: Azali kobeta ntango nyonso, mpe ebandi kobebisa boyokani na biso.

src: Therapist: It sounds like this is a really difficult situation for you.
trg: Monganga: Emonanaki neti ezali likambo ya mpasi mingi mpo na yo.

src: Client: It is. I don't know what to do.
trg: Kiliya: Ezali bongo. Nayebi te nasala nini.

src: I've tried talking to her about it, but she just gets defensive and says that I'm not being understanding.
trg: Nameka kosolola na ye mpo na yango, kasi azali komilongisa mpe alobi ete nazali te komitya na esika na ye.

src: Therapist: It's understandable that you're feeling frustrated.
trg: Monganga: Ezali normale ete olemba nzoto.

src: It's not easy to be on the receiving end of someone's anger.
trg: Ezali te pete na kozala moto oyo moto mosusu azali kosilikela.

src: Christianity is a religion based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ.
trg: Boklisto ezali lingomba oyo esimbami na bomoi mpe mateya ya Yesu Klisto.

src: It is one of the world's major religions, with over 2 billion followers.
trg: Ezali moko ya mangomba ya minene na mokili, ezali na bandimi koleka 2 miliare.

src: Christians believe that Jesus is the Son of God and that he came to earth to save people from their sins.
trg: Baklisto bandimaka ete Yezu azali Mwana ya Nzambe mpe ete ayaki na mabele mpo na kobikisa bato na masumu.

src: They also believe that he rose from the dead and ascended into heaven.
trg: Bandimaka mpe ete asekwaki na bakufi mpe amataki na likolo.

src: The importance of love for Jesus is central to Christianity.
trg: Ntina ya kolinga Yesu ezali na motuya mingi mpenza na Boklisto.

src: Christians are called to love God with all their heart, soul, mind, and strength.
trg: Basengaka Baklisto na kolinga Nzambe na motema, molimo, makanisi mpe makasi na bango nyonso.

src: They are also called to love their neighbors as themselves.
trg: Basengaka bango mpe na kolinga bazalani na bango ndenge bamilingaka.

src: This love is not just a feeling, but a way of life.
trg: Bolingo oyo ezali kaka te mayoki, kasi ezali lolenge ya bomoi.

src: It is expressed through acts of kindness, compassion, and forgiveness.
trg: Bamonisaka yango na nzela ya misala ya boboto, ya koyokela bato mawa, mpe kolimbisa.

src: When we love Jesus, we are not only showing our love for him, but we are also showing our love for God.
trg: Soki tozali kolinga Yesu, tozali kaka te komonisa bolingo na biso mpo na ye, kasi tozali mpe komonisa bolingo na biso mpo na Nzambe.

src: This is because Jesus is the perfect expression of God's love for us.
trg: Ezali bongo mpo Yezu azali lolenge ya kokota oyo Nzambe amonisela biso bolingo na ye.

src: When we love Jesus, we are opening ourselves up to receive God's love into our hearts.
trg: Soki tozali kolinga Yesu, tozali komifungolela nzela ya kozwa bolingo ya Nzambe na mitema na biso.

src: The love of Jesus is a powerful force that can transform our lives.
trg: Bolingo ya Yesu ezali nguya ya makasi oyo ebongolaka bomoi na biso.

src: It can give us hope, strength, and peace.
trg: Ekoki kopesa biso elikya, makasi, mpe kimya.

src: It can help us to forgive others and to love ourselves.
trg: Ekoki kosalisa biso na kolimbisa basusu mpe na komilinga.

src: One day, a young boy visited a museum with his parents.
trg: Mokolo moko, elenge mobali moko akendaki kotala mize na baboti na ye.

src: He was amazed by all the different things he saw, from ancient artifacts to modern art.
trg: Akamwaki biloko ya ndenge na ndenge oyo amonaki, banda na mayemi ya kala kino na art ya lelo.

src: He especially loved the dinosaur exhibit, and he could have spent hours just looking at the skeletons and fossils.
trg: Asepelaki mingi na dinozore, mpe alekisaki bangonga ebele kaka na kotala eskelete mpe biloko ya kala.

src: As he was admiring a particularly large dinosaur skull, he heard a voice behind him. "That's a Tyrannosaurus rex," the voice said.
trg: Ntango azalaki kosepela kotala mingimingi motu ya dinozore moko ya monene, ayokaki mongongo nsima na ye: "Ezali Tyranozore rex," wana maloba ya mongongo wana.

src: "It was one of the largest and most fearsome predators to ever walk the Earth."
trg: "Ezalaki moko ya banyama elyaka banyama mosusu ya monene mpe ya kobangisa oyo etikala kotambola na Mabele."

src: The boy turned around and saw a man standing next to him.
trg: Elenge wana abalukaki mpe amonaki mobali moko atelemi pene na ye.

src: He was tall and thin, with a long beard and a kind face. "Are you a paleontologist?" the boy asked.
trg: Azalaki molai mpe nzoto mike, na mandefu ya milai mpe elongi ya boboto. "Ozali moto ya mayele ya makambo ya kala?" wana motuna ya elenge.

src: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."
trg: "Ee, ezali bongo," wana eyano ya mobali wana. "Nabanda koyekola badinozore banda mibu ebele."

src: The boy was excited to meet a real paleontologist, and he asked him many questions about dinosaurs.
trg: Elenge wana asepelaki na kokutana na moto ya mayele ya solo ya makambo ya kala, mpe kotuna ye mituna ebele mpo na badinozore.

src: The man answered all of his questions patiently, and the boy learned a lot about these fascinating creatures.
trg: Mobali wana ayanolaki mituna na ye nyonso na motema molai, mpe elenge wana ayekolaki makambo ebele mpo na bikelamu wana ya kokamwa.

src: After a while, the boy's parents called him over, and he said goodbye to the paleontologist.
trg: Nsima ya mwa ntango, baboti ya mwana wana babengaki ye, mpe apesaki mbote ya nsuka na moto wana ya mayele ya makambo ya kala.

src: Freedom: A Personal Perspective
trg: Bonsomi: Makanisi ya Moto ye Moko

src: Freedom is a word that has been used and abused by so many people, in so many contexts, that it has almost lost its meaning.
trg: Bonsomi ezali liloba oyo bato mingi basalela mpe basalela mabe, na makambo ebele, yango wana ebungisa ndimbola na yango.

src: But for me, freedom is a very simple thing.
trg: Kasi mpo na nga, bonsomi ezali eloko ya pete mpenza.

src: It is the ability to live my life on my own terms, without being controlled or oppressed by others.
trg: Ezali makoki ya kovivre bomoi na nga na ndenge na nga moko, kozanga ete bato mosusu bayangela yo to banyokola.

src: I was born into a time and place where women were not considered to be fully equal to men.
trg: Nabotamaki na ntango mpe na esika oyo bato bazalaki komona te basi ete bazali ndenge moko na mibali.

src: We were expected to stay at home, raise children, and take care of our husbands.
trg: Bazalaki kozela ete totikala na ndako, tobokola bana, mpe kobatela mibali na biso.

src: But I never wanted to live that kind of life.
trg: Kasi nazalaki ata moke te kozala na bomoi ya ndenge wana.

src: I wanted to be free to pursue my own dreams, to learn and grow, and to make a difference in the world.
trg: Nazalaki kolinga kozala na bonsomi ya kolanda bandoto na nga moko, ya koyekola mpe kokola, mpe kosala bokeseni na mokili.

src: I was fortunate to have parents who supported my ambitions.
trg: Nazalaki na libaku malamu ya kozala na baboti oyo bazalaki kondima bamposa na nga.

src: They encouraged me to go to college, to get a job, and to live my life on my own terms.
trg: Balendisaki nga na kokende na collège, na kozwa mosala, mpe na kozala na bomoi oyo nga moko nalingi.

src: And I am grateful for the opportunities that I have had to travel, to meet new people, and to learn about different cultures.
trg: Mpe nazali na botondi mpo na mabaku oyo nazwaki na kosala mibembo, ya kokutana na bato, mpe ya koyekola ba culture ekeseni.

src: But I know that not everyone is as lucky as I was.
trg: Kasi nayebi ete bato nyonso te bazalaka na chance neti nga.

src: There are still many people in the world who are denied their freedom, simply because of their race, their gender, or their religion.
trg: Ezali kaka na bato ebele na mokili oyo bakanga bonsomi na bango, kaka mpo na mposo na bango, mpo bazali basi to mibale, to lingomba na bango.

src: A hospital is a healthcare institution providing patient treatment in an inpatient setting.
trg: Lopitalo ezali esika oyo bato ya maladi nkisi mingimingi baoyo bakoti na lopitalo.

src: Inpatient care is provided by hospital inpatient departments, emergency departments and outpatient clinics.
trg: Kosunga mobeli na lopitalo epesamaka na badepartema ya lopitalo, badepartema ya urgence mpe baklinike ya babeli balali na lopitalo te.

src: Hospitals are usually staffed by professional and registered nurses, physicians, and other health professionals.
trg: Balopitalo ezalaka mbala mingi na bato ba infirmier na minganga bayebi mosala mpe bakomisa nkombo mpe bato mosusu oyo basalaka mosala ya kimonganga.

src: A hospital can also include a number of support departments, such as medical records, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, and rehabilitation.
trg: Lopitalo ekoki kozala na badepartema ebele ya kosunga bato, neti badosie ya kimonganga, esika batekaka bankisi, laboratware, radiologie, mpe rehabilitation.

src: Hospitals are often classified by the type of care they provide, such as general hospitals, specialty hospitals, and psychiatric hospitals.
trg: Batyaka balopitalo mbala mingi na molongo na kolanda lisungi oyo bapesaka, neti balopitalo ya generale, balopitalo ya speciale, mpe balopitalo ya maladi ya moto.

src: General hospitals provide a wide range of services, including medical, surgical, obstetrical, and pediatric care.
trg: Balopitalo ya general ezalaka na misala ebele, neti ya kimonganga, ya lipaso, ya obstetrique, mpe ya bana.

src: Specialty hospitals focus on a particular type of care, such as cancer care, cardiac care, or orthopedic care.
trg: Balopitalo ya speciale etyaki likebi na basoin ya sikisiki neti maladi ya kansere, ya motema, mpe ya makolo.

src: Psychiatric hospitals provide care for people with mental illness.
trg: Balopitalo ya maladi ya moto ekipaka bato oyo babelaka maladi ya moto.

src: Hospitals are an important part of the healthcare system.
trg: Balopitalo ezali eteni ntina mingi ya ebongiseli ya kolongono ya nzoto.

src: They provide care for a variety of illnesses and injuries, and they play a vital role in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease.
trg: Esungaka mpo na maladi mpe bampota ya ndenge na ndenge, mpe ezala na mosala makasi na kokanga maladi nzela, komona yango, mpe kopesela yango nkisi.

src: Hospitals also provide education and training for healthcare professionals, and they conduct research to improve the quality of care.
trg: Balopitalo epesaka mpe mateya na formation na minganga, mpe esalaka bolukiluki mpo na kobongisa qualite ya lisungi bazali kopesa bato ya maladi.

src: The history of hospitals dates back to ancient times.
trg: Lisolo ya balopitalo ebanda na bantango ya kala.

src: The first hospitals were established in India, China, and Greece.
trg: Basalaki balopitalo ya libosoliboso na Inde, na Chine, mpe na Grese.

src: In the Middle Ages, hospitals were often run by religious organizations.
trg: Na Moyen Age, balopitalo ezalaki mbala mingi masanga ya losambo.

src: The first time I tried embroidery, I was determined to make a small, intricate design.
trg: Mbala ya liboso namekaki broderie, nazalaki na mokano ya kosala mayemi ya mike mpe ya mindondo.

src: I chose a pattern with lots of tiny stitches, and I started working on it with great enthusiasm.
trg: Naponaki modele ezali na bapoint ebele ya mike, mpe nabandaki kosala yango na esengo makasi.

src: However, after a few hours, I realized that I was making a mistake.
trg: Kasi, nsima ya bangonga moke, namonaki ete nazalaki kosala mabunga.

src: The stitches were too small and tight, and my hand was cramping up.
trg: Bapoint wana ezalaki mike mingi mpe ya kokangama, mpe maboko na nga ezalaki kokangama.

src: I decided to put the project aside and try something else.
trg: Nazwaki ekateli ya kotika mosala wana mpe komeka eloko mosusu.

src: The next time I tried embroidery, I chose a larger pattern with looser stitches.
trg: Mbala ya nsima oyo namekaki broderie, naponaki monene ya monene oyo ezali na bapoint mosikamosika.

src: This made a big difference!
trg: Esalaki mpenza bokeseni!

src: I was able to work on the project for longer periods of time without getting tired, and the stitches were easier to make.
trg: Nazalaki na makoki ya kosala wana bangonga ebele kozanga kolemba, mpe bapoint ezalaki pete na kosala.

src: I was also able to create a more beautiful result.
trg: Nakoki mpe kosala biloko oyo ezalaki kitoko mingi.

src: If you're new to embroidery, I recommend starting with a larger pattern with looser stitches.
trg: Soki ozali moto ya sika na broderie, nazali kolendisa yo na kobanda na mayemi ya minene oyo ezali na bapoint mosikamosika.

src: This will make it easier to learn the basic stitches and techniques.
trg: Ekozala pete mpo oyekola makambo ya ntina ya bapoint mpe bateknike.

src: Once you've mastered the basics, you can start experimenting with smaller patterns and tighter stitches.
trg: Soki oyebi makambo ya ntina, okoki kobanda komeka midele ya mike na bapoint ya pembeni.

src: The capital and largest city in Malawi is Lilongwe.
trg: Mboka-mokonzi mpe engumba eleki monene na Malawi ezali Lilongwe.

src: Malawi is a diverse country with a rich culture and history.
trg: Malawi ezali mboka ya bokeseni na culture mpe lisolo ya kitoko.

src: Some of the most important places in Malawi include Lake Malawi, the Shire River, and the Nyika Plateau.
trg: Moko ya bisika ya ntina mingi ya Malawi ezali Lac Malawi, Ebale Shire, mpe Plateau Nyika.

src: Lake Malawi is the third-largest lake in Africa and is home to a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.
trg: Lac Malawi ezali lac ya misato ya monene na Afrika mpe ezali na bambisi mpe biloko mosusu ya zamba ebele mpenza.

src: The Shire River is a major tributary of the Zambezi River and is an important source of water for irrigation and transportation.
trg: Ebale Shire ezali mwana ya Ebale Zambezi mpe ezali esika monene oyo bato bazwaki mai mpo na kotimola mpe komema.

src: The Nyika Plateau is a highland region in northern Malawi and is home to a variety of wildlife, including elephants, lions, and leopards.
trg: Plateau ya Nyika ezali mwa ngomba na norde ya Malawi mpe ezali na biloko ya zamba ebele, neti banzoko, bankosi, mpe bankoi.

src: Some of the most important historical figures in Malawi include David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, and Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
trg: Ndambo ya bato ya kala ya ntina mingi na lisolo ya Malawi ezali David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, mpe Hastings Kamuzu Banda.

src: Livingstone was a Scottish missionary and explorer who was instrumental in the abolition of the slave trade in Africa.
trg: Livingstone azalaki misionere ya Ecosse mpe mosali ya bolukiluki oyo asalaka makasi na kosilisa mosala ya koteka baindo na Afrika.

src: Chilembwe was a Malawian Baptist minister who led an uprising against British colonial rule in 1915.
trg: Chilembwe azalaki ministre ya Baptiste ya Malawi oyo akambaki botomboki kontre bokonzi ya nkanza ya Grande-Bretagne na 1915.

src: Banda was the first president of Malawi and ruled the country from 1964 to 1994.
trg: Banda azalaki prezida ya liboso ya Malawi mpe ayangelaki banda 1964 kino 1994.

src: The Golden Temple, a shimmering monument to human vanity and folly, stands as a testament to the destructive power of desire.
trg: Tempelo ya Wolo, monima moko ezali kongenga ya kozanga ntina mpe bozoba ya bato, etelemi mpo na komonisa nguya ya koboma ya mposa.

src: It is a place where dreams are made and broken, where hopes are raised and dashed, and where love and hate, life and death, are all inextricably intertwined.
trg: Ezali esika oyo bandoto esalemaka mpe ekufaka, esika bilikya ebimaki mpe ebebaka, mpe esika bolingo na koyina, bomoi na liwa, ezalaka ya kokangama makasi.

src: The temple was built by a wealthy maharaja who wanted to create a place where he could worship his god in peace.
trg: Batongaki tempelo wana na maharaja moko ya bozwi oyo alingaki kosala esika oyo akoki kosambela nzame na ye na kimya.

src: However, the temple quickly became a magnet for pilgrims from all over the world, and it soon became a place of commerce and trade.
trg: Kasi, tempelo ekomaki noki esika oyo bato ya mokili mobimba bazalaki koya kotala, pe ekomaki noki esika ya koteka mpe ya mombongo.

src: The maharaja's dream of a peaceful place of worship was quickly shattered, and the temple became a place of greed, corruption, and violence.
trg: Ndoto ya maharaja ya esika ya losambo ya kimya ebebaki noki, mpe tempelo ekomaki esika ya moimi, ya kozwa avoka mpe ya mobulu.

src: One day, a young man named Amritsar arrived at the temple.
trg: Mokolo moko, elenge mobali moko nkombo na ye Amritsar akomaki na tempelo.

src: He was a simple man with a simple dream: to find peace and happiness.
trg: Azalaki moto ya mpamba na ndoto ya pete: kozwa esika ya kimya mpe ya esengo.

src: However, Amritsar soon found that the temple was no place for peace.
trg: Kasi, Amritsar amonaki noki ete tempelo ezalaki te esika ya kimya.

src: He was drawn into the vortex of greed and corruption, and he eventually lost everything he had.
trg: Abendamaki na moimi mpe kozwa avoka, mpe nsukansuka abungisaka nyonso azalaki na yango.

src: Amritsar's story is a cautionary tale about the dangers of desire.
trg: Lisolo ya Amritsar ezali lisolo ezali kokebisa na likama oyo mposa ezalaka na yango.

src: It is a reminder that the things we crave most may not be what is best for us.
trg: Ezali ekundweli ete biloko tolukaka na mposa makasi ezali mbala mosusu te oyo ezali malamu mingi mpo na biso.

src: Hey there, how's it going?
trg: Boni kuna, ezali koleka ndenge nini?

src: I'm just your friendly neighborhood Uber driver, here to take you wherever you need to go.
